_about: Interstate highways only, for the ShareSchooling maps. Source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 primary roads (tl_2024_us_primaryroads), filtered to RTTYP = 'I'. License: public domain (U.S. government work). Projected with the same lower-48 Albers formula as data/map.json (d3.geoAlbersUsa scale 1300, translate [487.5, 305]) and simplified for display. Alaska and Hawaii are omitted because those states are drawn as insets, not in this projection. Regenerate with tools/build_roads.py.
